settings.heading: Product features
settings.content:
Compact Round Shape: 45 cm diameter tray top provides ample surface for drinks, books, or decor without crowding small spaces.

Ideal Height: 47 cm tall, perfect as a sofa or bedside table for easy reach.

Cross-Leg Frame: Sturdy X-shaped steel legs ensure stability on uneven floors.

High Load Capacity: Weighs only 2.5 kg for effortless portability but Supports up to 15 kg, suitable for lamps, vases, or snacks.

Anti-Rust Protection: Powder-coated finish resists corrosion, ideal for indoor/outdoor use.

settings.heading: Materials and care
settings.content:
Premium Construction: Made from high-grade powder-coated steel for rust resistance, scratch-proof surface, and long-lasting shine.

Cleaning: Wipe with a soft, damp cloth and mild soap; dry immediately to maintain finish.

Maintenance: Avoid harsh abrasives or acids; polish with metal-safe cleaner quarterly.

Tips: Keep indoors during heavy rain; do not overload beyond 20 kg.
